data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'sa'ama', meaning 'sky' or 'heaven'. Saama is a beautiful name that evokes images of the night sky and the peaceful serenity of the moon. The name Saama carries the meaning “Moon, Night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Saama usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, night and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saama total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
